public.تحرص الإدارة العامة للحجر الصحي القومي ع:
The Directorate General of National Quarantine is committed to protecting the health of citizens and travelers and ensuring safe movement across all entry points by applying the highest health standards in line with the International Health Regulations.

Coordination among national bodies is the cornerstone of a successful quarantine system; we continue to raise laboratory efficiency, update reference standards, and qualify personnel.

We call on all travelers to follow the approved health procedures to ensure a safe journey and a stable, healthy environment for everyone.
